title: Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue

The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.

Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

description: The Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue is optimized for upright naked and roadster riders seeking wide-angle road awareness, delivering responsive balance and confident road feel. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1291g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~86 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with a glove-friendly quick-release ratcheting buckle.
yoast_title: Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
introduction: Positioned in Ruroc's Full Face lineup, the Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue brings British engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 track safety.
story:
The Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue represents Ruroc's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
